prompt:
A real photograph, vertical frame, taken from a chair at one side of a single light wooden table in a
small, quiet seminar room of an adult education centre in Berlin, on a bright afternoon, empty of
people.

The light wooden table top runs across the bottom of the picture, bare and clean. On the far side of
the table, facing the camera, stands one empty grey upholstered chair with a light wooden frame. Behind
it, an off-white wall. On the right of the picture, a tall window with a white frame lets in soft
daylight from the right, which falls across the table top and the chair; through the glass, the pale
leaves of a tree. On the left, the off-white wall runs on, bare. The floor is pale grey linoleum.

The textures of real wood, fabric, painted plaster and glass, as a visitor would take it with a good
phone camera.
